verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪੈਰੁ ਧਰਿ ਦਹਿਦਿਸਿ ਬਾਰਹ ਵਾਟ ਨ ਧਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmukh maarag pair dhar dhahidhis baareh vaaT na dhaiaa|

en.bdb: The guru-oriented treading the path leading towards the Guru does not stray into the paths of the twelve sects of the yogis.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਧਰਿ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmoorat gur dhiaan dhar ghaT ghaT pooran braham dhikhaiaa|

en.bdb: Concentrating on the form of Guru i.e. Word of the Guru, he adopts it in life and comes face to :face with the perfect Brahm.

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਬਦ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਲਿਵ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਜਣਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: sabadh surat upadhes liv paarabraham gur giaan janaiaa|

en.bdb: Concentration of consciousness on the word of the Guru and knowledge bestowed by the Guru provides the awareness about the transcendental Brahm .

verses.gurmukhi: ਸਿਲਾ ਅਲੂਣੀ ਚਟਣੀ ਚਰਣ ਕਵਲ ਚਰਣੋਦਕੁ ਪਿਆਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: silaa aloonee chaTanee charan kaval charanodhak piaaiaa|

en.bdb: Only such a persen quaffs the nectar of feet-wash of the Guru.

verses.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਿਹਚਲੁ ਚਿਤ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਟ ਵਿਚਿ ਨਿਜ ਘਰੁ ਛਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: gurmat nihachal chit kar sukh sa(n)paT vich nij ghar chhaiaa|

en.bdb: This however is nothing less than licking of the tasteless stone. He stablizes his mind in the wisdom of the Guru and reclines comfortably in the chamber of his inner self.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰ ਤਨ ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰਹਰੇ ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿ ਅਪਰਸੁ ਰਹਾਇਆ।
verses.translit_en: par tan par dhan parahare paaras paras aparas rahaiaa|

en.bdb: Touching the philosopher's stone in the form of the Guru , he repudiating the wealth and physical body of others remains detached from all.
For curing his chronic maladies (of evil propensities) he goes to the holy congregation.
